services.name: Lord Baltimore Ghost Tours
services.desc: The Lord Baltimore Hotel has been standing since 1928, which is long enough to accumulate opinions, architectural quirks, and, depending on who you ask, a few residents who never quite checked out. There's Molly, for starters. She has a way of making herself known. We'll leave it at that. Then there's the Lady in Gray, who has been spotted more times than the hotel's management is entirely comfortable discussing. The Maid, who seems to have strong feelings about certain floors. The Dancing Couple, because apparently even the afterlife has people who refuse to let a good ballroom go to waste. And others. Quite a few others, actually. blurb: Begin at LB Tavern, the Lord Baltimore Hotel's modern take on a classic hotel bar, with handcrafted cocktails, local craft beer, and dinner available under the same roof as the theatre. Then find your seat for world-class magic and stay for a ghost tour or an after-hours performance. Arrive at least 90 minutes early for dinner or 30 minutes early for drinks.
